1. -webkit-background-clip

Red is the background. The gray ring is padding. Border-box paints red through the padding. Content-box leaves the padding gray.

Both boxes are declared 100 by 40. zoom: 2 paints the green one at 200 by 80.

6. line-fit-edge

Both words have the same padding. leading makes that padding part of the line. text keeps the padding out of the line, so the line is shorter.

leading

7. inline-sizing

The line is 32px tall. normal paints red behind the letters. stretch paints red for the whole line.

normal stretch

Same words, same width. The second paragraph starts every line 24px further in.

9. box-decoration-break

Top is one red bar. Bottom gives each wrapped line its own box.

slice

10. SVG geometry from a stylesheet

Each pair is one shape. Left is the attribute. Right is the same shape after the stylesheet moves it. They are separate pictures so one shape cannot cover the others.

circle, cx cy r

rect, x y

ellipse, rx ry

11. -webkit-mask-composite

The prefixed composite accepts the extra Porter-Duff words. This page cannot replay mask pixels. The drawing list stores them.

source-atop, clear, copy

12. mask-type

alpha treats the mask as opacity. luminance treats black as a hole. The finished mask pixels are a host replay. The stylesheet value is what changed.

alpha keeps a mark. luminance does not.

13. backdrop-filter

The green box carries blur(8px) saturate(1.4) on its group. This window does not blur the pixels behind it. The group still has the filter string. none does not open a group.

14. break-inside

Three 40px boxes in two columns. avoid moves the middle box into the second column. auto leaves it under the first.

auto 1
auto 2

avoid 1
avoid 2

15. size

size: 120px 40px versus size: 120px, which sets both axes.

16. min-size

A 50 by 20 box with min-size: 120px becomes 120 by 120.

17. max-size

A 300 by 200 box with max-size: 180px 60px paints at 180 by 60.

18. all

The parent is blue. initial clears the child fill. inherit keeps the blue.

none keeps the zero-width space. space turns it into a normal space.

20. string-set

The heading assigns its text. The line under it reads that string back.

Guide One

string-set:

21. marker

The stylesheet gives all three vertices an arrow. The right path has none.

22. marker-start

Only the first vertex gets the arrow.

23. marker-mid

Only the middle vertex gets the arrow.

24. marker-end

Only the last vertex gets the arrow.

25. stop-color

Left: the first stop is red. Right: the stylesheet makes it green.

26. stop-opacity

The right gradient above also has stop-opacity: 0.5 on its first stop, so it fades in from the left edge.

27. paint-order

The stylesheet asks for stroke first, so the red fill covers the inner half of the blue stroke instead of the stroke sitting on top.

28. path-length

path-length: 100 rescales the dash lengths to a 100 unit path. The line is 180 units long, so each dash is 1.8 times longer than its written 10 and 5.

29. link-parameters

An SVG image reads env(--color). param(--color: #ff0000) fills the left image red. This window supplies the image file. Left: param(--color: #ff0000). Right: none.

30. continue

Both paragraphs have max-height: 40px. The first one has continue: collapse, so it keeps two lines. The second keeps all of them and spills.

one two three four five six seven eight nine ten eleven twelve thirteen

one two three four five six seven eight nine ten eleven twelve thirteen

31. margin-break

The second box starts column 2 and has a 16px margin-top. discard (left) puts it at the column top. keep (right) leaves the 16px gap.

32. image-rendering

The blue and orange picture is stretched to 192 by 96 with optimizeSpeed. This window does not resample differently. The image op carries the keyword for a host that does.

33. vector-effect

Both lines have stroke-width 6 in a viewBox four times larger than the picture. The left one scales down to a thin line. non-scaling-stroke (right) keeps the 6 pixel width.

34. flood-color

A filter with one feFlood replaces the blue rect with a green flood over the filter region, which is the box plus 10 percent on every side.

35. flood-opacity

The flood above is at 0.6 opacity, so the page color shows through it.

36. -webkit-text-stroke

The shorthand takes a width and a color. Blue glyphs outlined in red, 2px wide. The drawing list carries the width and color. This window draws the outline by repeating the text around each glyph, under the fill, so only the outer half of the stroke shows and it looks lighter than a browser's.

Stroke

37. -webkit-text-stroke-width

With no color longhand the outline follows the fill. 0 paints nothing, 1px is thin, thick is wider.

Aa Aa Aa

38. -webkit-text-stroke-color

White glyphs on a dark box, outlined in orange. The color longhand only matters once the width is above 0.
